$comment: Line-coverage floors for the host scripts under the bats unit tests (tests/unit), measured with kcov in a Fedora container by .github/workflows/coverage-gate.yml and enforced by scripts/coverage-gate.mjs. kcov measures only lines for Bash. The tests run each script from a scratch copy of the repo at one fixed path (APPBOX_TEST_REPO), so 'file' is matched as a path suffix in kcov's per-file list. These floors are provisional: they were set before kcov had ever run on this repo (it cannot run on the machine the tests were written on), deliberately low. Raise each floor to a few points below the number the first CI run reports, and add a 'measured' entry with that number. Floors only go up; a human edits this file.
